extName.message: PlainSight: Hide AI Overviews & AI Mode for Google Search™
extName.description: Store and toolbar name. Max 75 characters. Keep "PlainSight" and "Google Search™".

extDescription.message: Remove AI Overviews and AI Mode from Google Search. Get classic web results back. Free, open source, no tracking.

showFullResults.description: Link on the results page in Web only mode. Pauses PlainSight for the tab.

modeHideAiHint.message: Normal Google results without AI Overviews and AI Mode buttons.

modeWebOnlyHint.message: Every search opens in Google's Web filter: links only, no AI, no images or maps.

modeOffHint.message: PlainSight does nothing until you turn it back on.

blockAiModeHint.message: Opening AI Mode takes you to regular results instead.

hiddenCount.description: Local counter shown in the popup.

pausedNotice.message: Paused on this tab until you close it.

hostAccessMissing.message: PlainSight needs access to Google Search pages to work.

welcomeIntro.message: Choose how Google Search should look. You can change this any time from the PlainSight toolbar button.

welcomeDifference.message: Hide AI keeps the normal Google page and removes the AI parts. Web only switches to Google's own Web filter, which shows links only and keeps working even when Google changes its page.

welcomeSaved.message: Saved. You can close this tab and search as usual.

privacyNote.message: PlainSight collects no data. Your settings stay in your browser and the counter never leaves your device.

supportText.message: PlainSight is free and open source. If it makes your searches better, you can support its development.

aiExporter.description: Name of another extension by the same developer. Do not translate.

statusHidden.message: AI Overview hidden on this page.
statusHidden.description: Popup line when PlainSight hid an AI Overview on the current tab.

statusKept.message: Something here looked like AI but was left visible to keep your results safe.
statusKept.description: Popup notice when a safety guard left an AI-looking block visible.

hidePeopleAlsoAsk.description: Option. Use Google's exact name of the "People also ask" box.

hidePeopleAlsoAskHint.message: Google now writes almost all of these answers with AI.
